text:
maya: Opening a tiny PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-world tutorial. Plan: simplify auth wording, add a one-line curl smoke test, include a brief Vercel serverless example using an ephemeral token, and update one SDK snippet to v8 client usage. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5833 (WIP).
ryan: Please separate the SDK snippet swap into its own commit so review/revert is easier.
nora: Add a curl example under 'Test locally' — most users try that first.
maya: Adding this curl snippet:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
```
ryan: Also add a one-liner about pinning model versions (e.g. model: "redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01") to avoid silent regressions.
maya: Will do. Also adding local smoke steps: `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl. Note about clearing KV cache if responses look stale.
nora: Tiny nit: keep env var name consistent as REDWOOD_API_KEY in all examples.
maya: Affirmed. Fixed the broken deploy link and added the Vercel handler note (cache ephemeral token per invocation).
deploy-bot: preview for PR 5833 queued (ETA ~6m) — will post preview link when ready.
ryan: I'll review the SDK commit after the preview. If green, merge and open follow-up to migrate remaining snippets.
maya: Thanks — merging after CI if preview is green. Closing thread.
